findings.problem: The plan treats option (c) as a decision covering caveats, but the cited decision explicitly chose (c) only for inferred topics and key ideas and left caveats and limits outside that decision. Adding `excerpt_mark` for caveats therefore expands the decided work without owner direction.
findings.suggestion: Limit `excerpt_mark` to topics and key ideas, returning `null` for caveats, or obtain and record an owner decision that includes caveats before planning their search-result treatment.

findings.location: Assumptions and constraints, “Which item the excerpt is from is not recorded today”; Increment A, steps 1–3; Completion criteria 1 and 3
findings.problem: A single mark cannot reliably describe the current excerpt. The excerpt is cut from the joined list text and can cross item boundaries, including items with different marks. Moreover, the FTS index matches tokens while `excerpt_of` finds the first regex substring, so it can visibly excerpt an earlier item that did not supply the indexed match. Choosing the first indexed item would then label text from another item, violating criterion 3.
findings.suggestion: Specify and test a deterministic contract before implementation: make excerpts for marked lists stay within one item and use the same token-boundary matching as the index, or return `null` whenever the displayed excerpt cannot be attributed to exactly one marked item. Include boundary-crossing and substring/token-mismatch cases in the required tests.

summary: The plan aligns with the roadmap candidate and card spec in general, but it extends the recorded decision to caveats and does not yet define a reliable item-to-excerpt mapping.
